name: pg_predicate_nulltest_deduction_clone
area: planner, null tests in outer joins
goal:
The planner can reduce an IS NULL or IS NOT NULL join condition to a constant after that condition has been duplicated across an outer-join transformation, even though the referenced column is nullable in the transformed location. The resulting plan returns the wrong number of rows.

Build a chain of left joins in which a NOT NULL column from an inner table is first made nullable, then used by a later join condition. Conditions `t3.b IS NOT NULL` and `t3.b IS NULL AND t3.a IS NOT NULL` must remain effective and return the same rows as the SQL outer-join semantics require. Safe constant reductions on original conditions over columns that cannot be null-extended must remain available.
